_about: CONTROL_A / CONTROL_B cells for the M02 redo quintuplet (docket [5064]). One compatible-conjunction companion per pole, so that BOTH can be compared against a cell matched on length and conjunction and differing ONLY in compatibility.
_convention: NEAR-SYNONYM: the companion sits on the SAME semantic dimension as its pole and on the SAME side of it. loyal -> dutiful, not loyal -> brave. Ruling at docket [5066].1; the argument is malign's own [5037] rule that a control differing from its comparison cell in two respects controls neither. DIFFERENT-TRAIT varies compatibility AND dimensionality at once and was rejected for that reason. SHARED POLE TAKES THE SAME COMPANION: f11_beauty and f11_beauty_ugly share POLE_A ('He was beautiful and she wanted to') and both take 'beautiful and radiant'. Stated as part of the convention rather than left as a coincidence, so a later author cannot diverge them and quietly introduce a between-group difference into a shared cell.
_authoring: Each companion was written to be idiomatic and read against its pole and against the BOTH cell's surface form, so that the control matches BOTH's syntax rather than merely its word count. Where the pole is a CATEGORY rather than a gradable trait, no natural same-dimension companion exists; those triplets are FLAGGED rather than silently switched to different-trait, per [5066].1.
_status: PROPOSED. Not generated. Awaiting registrar's registration and malign's manifest.

DEEPER PROBLEM, NOT FIXABLE BY A CONTROL: f11_holy's own POLES differ in adjective AND noun (holy temple / filthy alley), so the triplet was confounded before any control existed. f11_holy_b ('holy place' / 'filthy place') is the clean version of the same contrast and should be preferred as canonical; f11_holy is retained but must not be pooled with it.

flagged_no_natural_companion.reason: The pole is a CATEGORY, not a gradable trait. 'a man and male' is pleonasm; 'a man and a husband' changes dimension to social role, which is exactly the different-trait control the convention rejects. No same-dimension same-side companion exists in idiomatic English.
As f11_gender. 'a mother and a parent' is a hypernym, not a same-level companion.

Category again, and the BOTH cell is a COMPOUND NOUN ('The human-animal stood') rather than a conjunction, so a conjunction control does not match its surface form at all. 'The human figure' / 'The animal creature' were considered and rejected as hypernym padding rather than same-dimension conjunction.

_counts.note: 34, not the 46 estimated at [5064].3. The gap is the six category-pole triplets, where the convention says flag rather than substitute. Six fewer cells to generate and six fewer to code; the flagged triplets keep their A/B/BOTH and simply carry no conjunction control, so they contribute to every contrast except the primary.
